facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim used his brain, not his muscles. Thinking is a strong power. Smart plans beat big fists. He survived by thinking.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim was not the strongest person on the island. But he had a powerful brain that helped him solve problems. While pirates used force, Jim used clever strategies. He found the pirates' weaknesses and made smart plans. He survived by thinking. Thinking clearly is the greatest weapon anyone can have.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Throughout the adventure, Jim proved that intelligence is far more valuable than physical strength. While the pirates relied on brute force and threats to get what they wanted, Jim used his mind. He observed carefully, remembered details, and created strategies to overcome challenges. When he recaptured the ship, it was his quick thinking that made it possible. He survived by thinking. However, thinking well requires patience and the ability to stay calm under pressure. Because Jim trained himself to observe before acting, he always found solutions others missed. This taught him that the mind is the most powerful tool any person can possess.
